note: Authored from docs/spec; expected facts are derived by tools/fixtures/movement, not by packages/core. No state or draw hashes: later entries assert those.
tick: 60 Hz fixed; phases input, waits, threads, events, movement, edges, triggers, animation, audio, time (AD-26); random encounters hand off from triggers.
units: board pixels; fractions are exact multiples of 1/256

cases.name: axial-around-wall
cases.note: Mode 1: 4-way A* over the 32 px grid, Manhattan cost, around a wall; the final point is the exact goal.

cases.name: diagonal-around-wall
cases.note: Mode 2: 8-way A*, octile cost; shorter than the axial path around the same wall.

cases.name: vector-around-wall
cases.note: Mode 3: visibility graph over obstacle corners grown by the collision base; straight segments between corners.

cases.name: blocked-goal-nearest-free
cases.note: E-34: a blocked goal moves to the nearest free node (ties by node coordinate); the walker stops adjacent to the sprite goal.

cases.name: tie-order-is-total
cases.note: AD-25: equal-cost routes tie by node coordinate then insertion index; the chosen route is part of the fixture (open field, goal two cells diagonal).

cases.name: unreachable-goal-approaches
cases.note: E-34: an enclosed goal is unreachable; the 1000-expansion cap ends the search and the walker approaches the expanded node nearest the goal.

cases.name: cache-hit-edit-flush-and-new-route
cases.note: Results are cached per board and invalidated by a vector edit: the repeat query hits, the edit flushes, the next query misses and routes around the new wall.
